title: The secret kitchen of Tirumala
caption:
Inside Tirumala temple there's a secret kitchen 🤯 It makes around 3 lakh laddus every day.

📍 Laddu Potu, Tirumala, Andhra Pradesh (the temple is on Venkatadri, the 7th of the 7 hills)
👨‍🍳 About 620 cooks
🗓️ Laddu prasadam since 1715 (300+ years)

Every single day:
🌾 10 tonnes gram flour
🍚 10 tonnes sugar
🥜 700 kg cashews
🍇 540 kg raisins
🌿 150 kg cardamom

1️⃣ Batter drops into hot ghee and becomes boondi
2️⃣ Mixed with sugar syrup, cashews, raisins and cardamom
3️⃣ Rolled by hand

GI tag since 2009. On big festival days the kitchen can make up to 8 lakh laddus in a day.
